The '''Pterathki''' were a flying species native to [[Makeb]]<ref name="codex" /> and [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="onderon" />

==Biology and Appearance==
Pterathki were aerial creatures, capable of staying in the air for an indefinite amount of time. They had two wings and two equally-long arms; each limb had four digits. Pterathki had four red eyes, in pairs on each side of the head. Their bodies ended with a colorful double tail,<ref name="creature" /> which the creatures used to to attract prey (usually small animals) before spearing them with stabs of their powerful beaks.<ref name="codex" />

Although there is little meat on a pterathki, they are known to be particularly delicious to the Hutt palate when basted in Dantooine cane syrup. Since Makeb's takeover, Hutt Cartel forces have been seen attempting to net pterathkis for their masters' tables--and earning scars from angry pterathki beaks.

==History==
At the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] the amount of pterathki seen flying over the Makeb's settlements significantly increased; it was widely suspected that Makeb's groundquakes,<ref name="codex" /> caused by the intensified drilling of Isotope 5<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>, leveled a major pterathki nest, forcing pterathki to move. The catastrophic events on Makeb, however, did not end the species; years later several other populations of pterathki were observed, like the one on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="onderon" />

==In cookery==
Although there was little meat on the body of the Pterathki, they were known to be particularly delicious to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] palate, especially when covered in [[Dantooine cane syrup|Dantooine Cane Syrup]]. After the [[Conquest of Makeb|takeover of Makeb]], [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] forces started netting Pterathki for their [[Hutt/Legends|masters]], though hunting pterathki proved hazardous.<ref name="codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pterathki first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|Rise of the Hutt Cartel]] expansion of the video game, [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]. They later reappeared on the planet of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].
